prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is close, pick it up, check properties and perform task, else approach object or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = PerformSpecificTask    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />  <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />      <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />      <SubTree ID = PerformSpecificTask    />      <Action ID = PickUpObject    />  </Sequence> <Fallback>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />          <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />          <SubTree ID = PerformSpecificTask    />         <Action ID = PickUpObject    />      </Sequence>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />         <SubTree ID = ApproachObject    />      </Sequence>      <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />  </Fallback>"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
				DO PickUpObject
		ELSE
			DO CheckObjectProperties
			DO PerformSpecificTask
		END
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
				DO ApproachObject
		END
		DO ScanAreaForObject
	END
